description: Fetch observations from an ABS dataflow. dataKey is a dot-separated SDMX filter with one position per dimension (order from dataflow_structure); each position is a code, "+"-joined codes, or empty for wildcard. Pass "all" to fetch everything (can be large). Returns decoded series with their dimension labels and time-indexed values. Fetch dataflow_structure first to learn the dimension order and valid codes.

dataKey.description: Dot-separated dimension filter, e.g. "1.10001.10.50.Q" or "all". Empty positions are wildcards.

maxSeries.description: Cap decoded series returned (default 100). The raw response may contain thousands.

name: get_data
title: Get Data
